description:
The esure plugin, provided by esure Services Limited, lets you get a quote for esure Car Insurance. It uses ChatGPT, an AI service operated by OpenAI. Your conversations take place within the ChatGPT platform and are subject to OpenAI's terms and conditions. ChatGPT and its technology are owned and operated by OpenAI, not esure.

If you request a quote from esure, your request will be sent to esure and our response will appear in a clearly labelled esure-branded section displaying the esure logo. esure is responsible for that content. The rest of the chat experience and AI functionality is provided by OpenAI. Although esure will aim to help with information related to your insurance questions, esure does not provide advice through the plugin.

esure Car Insurance is arranged and administered by esure Services Limited and underwritten by esure Insurance Limited.

Use of your data

esure will use your personal data for purposes including assessing whether we can offer you insurance and generating your quote. For a motor insurance quote or policy purchase, esure Insurance Limited is the relevant controller of your personal data. esure Services Limited is responsible for the sale and distribution of the insurance product.

For more information about how we process your personal data, please see our privacy notice.

defaultPrompt: Help me get a car insurance quote.
I want to get a quote for car insurance.
